verdict.rationale: Gumloop is an AI agent and automation platform, so configurable retry and backoff for failed steps is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents automatic retries, backoff policies, or error-handling configuration. The triggers, human-in-the-loop, sandbox and webhook evidence covers adjacent features and earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure automatic retries with backoff for failed steps or activities
